articles.title: A Video Game Just Showed Hollywood How to Make a Better Halo Movie
articles.summary: The new Halo: Campaign Evolved remake is so good that it proves movies should tell NEW stories, not just copy the game. The old TV show tried something different, but fans hated it because it changed too much. Now, the only way forward is to be original.

articles.title: A Mexican Band and a Rap Legend Threw a Rain-Soaked Party in a Baseball Stadium
articles.summary: Fuerza Regida, a band from California, ended their first U.S. stadium tour at New York's Citi Field. Special guests included 50 Cent, Bobby Shmurda, and J Balvin. The show mixed Mexican corridos with hip-hop, and even a thunderstorm couldn't stop the fun.

articles.title: The Secret Drum Machine That Built Hip-Hop (and It Only Lived for Two Years!)
articles.summary: The Roland TR-808 drum machine was only sold from 1980 to 1982, but its booming beats shaped hip-hop forever. Songs like 'Planet Rock' and 'It's Tricky' used it, and Kanye West named a whole album after it. Here are 13 tracks that prove the 808 is legendary.
